mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `student_profile` ( user_id, real_name, school, college, major, grade, class_name, student_no, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{realName}, #{school}, #{college}, #{major}, #{grade}, #{className}, #{studentNo}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `student_profile` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT * FROM `student_profile` WHERE school = #{school} AND student_no = #{studentNo} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `student_profile` SET real_name = #{realName}, school = #{school}, college = #{college}, major = #{major}, grade = #{grade}, class_name = #{className}, student_no = #{studentNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
